board_records.construction: 全翼按内/外边界站位排序的真实摔网飞椽轨与正身边界飞椽轨及椽间插值点构造单一宽向B样条截面场；统一使用全翼纵向/横向切向求局部厚度偏置，内缘取实际里口外缘S轨、外缘取E轨及两端半档；上下共用参数的连续插值曲面直接封成每翼单一BRep。

combination_info.upper_profile: circle through dynamically sampled old/young corner top at endpoints and the configured back_join_fraction station with chord-relative downward sagitta; cross-width top offsets interpolate from actual old/young top surfaces
combination_info.lower_profile: F(u,v)=highest surface of only current old_corner/young_corner solids; mesh sampled at 1mm tessellation then new material cut against both BReps
combination_info.split_rule: z_split=0.5*(min_u F(u,0)+min_u U(u)); lower菱角木, upper扁担木; both share horizontal interface
combination_info.top_material_contact: new stock cut by old_corner+young_corner; lower boundary conforms to actual corner top mesh, with 0.2mm stock allowance before BRep cut
combination_info.back_join_parameter_interpretation: 弦向分位；从B点沿接背弦量到老/嫩戗接背控制站位，不是面积比
combination_info.historical_height_rule_status: book p128 states combined height >= 2/3 of the flying-corner horizontal level, but the datum is unresolved; current t=0.7 does not prove that criterion
assumptions: 接背上轮廓由动态端点与back_join_fraction处弦偏共同确定为圆弧
组合木宽度按嫩戗梢部宽度比例
组合侧轮廓与BRep切配为几何拟合，不等同传统榫接验证

arc.construction: A处以正身檐端线y=e为水平切线，圆弧向步桁侧内凹；半径由A切线及端点B唯一确定
arc.bulge_side: 弦线内侧、向步桁方向（y更小）

fan_geometry.n_definition: n为最小奇数等弧长区间数，A=L弧/n；每侧由内部i/n分点(i=1..n-1)生成n-1根摔网椽，弧端点仅作边界控制
fan_geometry.construction: 基准翼由O向弧线内部i/n等分点放射；邻根按相邻分点之间的中界扇区割角，弧端点不另生摔网；第二翼由同一实体刚体镜像到建筑角平分面的另一侧，不以整宽共点插入老戗。

eave_rafters_geometry.vertical_rule: 直椽底线z=90-0.5*y-12mm；沿全长保持原线性纵坡和放置基准，不在桁位切座或抬高。
eave_rafters_geometry.construction: 边界普通出檐椽中心线位于old_start.x，与fan_surface.A端同轴并计一次；其余正身出檐椽由边界按B向外等档排列，保持既有有效尾端范围。

upper_board_domain.domain_source: 实际里口外缘q_S至飞椽梢端q_E的全翼连续曲面边界；两端沿既有S/E轨外推半档，不再裁到旧中心线折线Ω。
upper_board_domain.top_source: stage05飞椽共享顶场的全宽轨与椽间线性插值
upper_board_domain.cross_width_interpolation: shared plan-chord parameter tensor B-spline interpolation
upper_board_domain.longitudinal_interpolation: shared uniform station parameter cubic B-spline interpolation
upper_board_domain.thickness_source: one continuous full-wing surface normal approximation, not per-flyer width-band offsets
